name: passenger arrival intensity
definition: Rate of passenger-group arrivals to the terminal
source_or_basis: To be varied independently and then coupled to flight schedule

name: aircraft arrival intensity
definition: Rate of aircraft arriving for service

name: passenger arrival lead time
definition: Time from passenger terminal arrival to scheduled departure

name: check-in service time
definition: Service time at check-in counter or kiosk

name: security or access service time
definition: Service time at security or access control

name: pad occupancy time
definition: Exclusive occupation time for a pad movement

name: stand turnaround time
definition: Time a stand or gate is held by an eVTOL

name: charging duration
definition: Duration of charging if charging is required
source_or_basis: Derived later from energy requirement and charger power

name: number of pads
source_or_basis: EASA PTS-VPT-DSN modular baseline one FATO-TLOF

name: number of stands or gates
definition: Available aircraft positions serving passenger interface
source_or_basis: EASA PTS-VPT-DSN modular baseline one stand

name: eVTOL delay
definition: Queueing and blocking delay before required movement or departure

name: passenger LoS threshold
definition: Maximum accepted wait or total terminal time

name: LoS compliance
definition: Share of passengers satisfying declared LoS proxy
source_or_basis: Compare VAR-012 and total time to VAR-014

name: throughput
definition: Completed passenger eVTOL departures per hour

name: resource utilization
definition: Busy time divided by available time for each resource

name: slot release rule
definition: Policy that admits or reschedules arrivals and departures
source_or_basis: Scheduled baseline informed by FAA UAM ConOps and DECEA; FCFS benchmark
